harnessDisclosure: ONE arm of the pre-registered A/B, captured against build "promoted-d8a9a16" in its own scratch Chrome (open -na "Google Chrome" --args --remote-debugging-port=9224 --user-data-dir=/tmp/t005-serving-chrome --no-first-run --disable-background-timer-throttling --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding), at the four registered poses in the registered order, with 20000 ms of settle before each 6000 ms frame sample. The bundle carries VITE_EXTERIOR_SCHEDULER_PROBE=1 because the residency and cache columns are read out of that probe's DOM payload; the probe reads state the app already holds and decides nothing. Frame durations are requestAnimationFrame deltas — the browser's own presentation cadence — and the first delta of each sample is dropped because it spans the gap since the previous paint rather than a rendered frame. The caps above are the ones COMPILED INTO THIS BUILD, which is the whole reason the arms are captured separately.
